AE Studio is mining roughly eighty million pages of Spanish colonial bureaucracy, ship manifests, admiralty filings, and insurance records with large language models to triangulate the locations of undiscovered shipwrecks and lost cargo. The model produces coordinates. The model does not swim. That is where you come in.

## II. Articles of service

### Required of the applicant

- Lifetime nautical experience. Open ocean, blue water, multi-day passages.

- Demonstrated ability to dive in conditions insurance companies decline to cover.

- Salvage, free-dive, or commercial dive certifications, or the lived equivalent.

- Comfortable with cold-start expeditions in unfamiliar jurisdictions. You handle permits, port officials, customs, and the occasional moray eel.

- Bias toward action. You read the coordinates, you go.

- Willing to be wrong publicly. Expect the first sites to be empty. The hit rate improves.

- Discretion. The find is the only thing that matters until it is secured.

- Physically capable. This is hard work in salt water.

### Counted as merit

- Prior salvage of anything older than 1800.

- Working Spanish, Portuguese, or Dutch. Most of the corpus is in these languages.

- Existing relationships with admiralty lawyers in Spain, Portugal, the UK, or any Caribbean state.

- Hands-on experience with side-scan sonar, magnetometers, or sub-bottom profilers.

- Sailing certifications above bareboat.

- Operational experience in Somalia, Hormuz, or Malacca.

- You already own a seaworthy vessel.

- You have read Peter Turchin or read Asimov's Foundation for fun.

## III. Articles of compensation

#### Equity

Founder-level stake in the venture. Granted at price zero for tax purposes. 100 percent retained on Skunkworks spin-out.

#### Cash

Advance for gear, vessel hire, and crew. Base salary $50,000 to $500,000, weighted heavily toward upside.

#### Recovery share

Profit share on recovered cargo, settled after admiralty proceedings and finder's costs. Structure modeled on Odyssey Marine and similar precedents.

#### Title and insurance

Jurisdiction-dependent and handled by counsel before any vessel leaves port. We carry the legal cost. You carry the rope.

## IV. From the model's log

## Sign the articles

Send a one-page brief on the most interesting wreck you would chase if we handed you a vessel tomorrow. Tell us why that one. Include your nautical record, your dive log highlights, and any salvage you can talk about publicly.
